title: StockSmart Supply Desk Table — Open Backorders and the Supply Share on Opening Consigned Stock
content:
For the opening consigned stock of a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines, Corbett holds back opening stock of an item its supply has recently failed at the program's ship-to.

**Rule.** Backorders of the transferred item opened at the program's ship-to in the last three months put a supply share into the carried share: where more were opened than were filled or cancelled in those months, 0.6; where some were opened and as many or more were filled or cancelled in those months, 0.9; where none was opened, no supply share is put in.

The backorders are read from the order history of the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account: lines of the item backordered, backorders filled and backorders cancelled. The last three months hold rows of age below three, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

| Opened in the window | Filled or cancelled in the window | Supply share |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1 | 0.6 |
| 2 | 2 | 0.9 |
| 1 | 3 | 0.9 |
| 0 | any | none put in |
